abstract: A series of 25 patients with malignant teratoma of the ovary is presented. In 56%, diagnosis was made before the age of 20; none had bilateral tumors, and 52% were in Stage I at the time of the original diagnosis. Treatment with operation followed by irradiation or single-agent chemotherapy was ineffective; there were no survivors in eight patients treated with either of these regimens. However, combination chemotherapy with vincristine, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide used postoperatively appears to be more effective since 10 to 12 patients who were treated with this method are surviving. Histologic grade appears to have questionable prognostic significance.
abstract_ja: 卵巣悪性奇形腫の患者25例を報告する。56%は20歳前に診断され、両側性の腫瘍は1例もなかった。52%は初診時に病期Iであった。手術後に放射線照射または単剤化学療法を行った治療は無効であり、これら2つのレジメンのいずれかで治療を受けた8例に生存者はいなかった。しかし、術後に併用化学療法としてビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミドを用いた場合はより有効と思われ、この方法で治療を受けた10～12例が生存している。組織学的グレードの予後的意義は疑わしい。
